preconditions.description: n is the number of vertices (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^6), and k is the move-up restriction (1 ≤ k < n).

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n - 1 and all(1 <= parent <= n for parent in p)
preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n-1 parent vertices, each between 1 and n, forming a valid tree rooted at 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n for i in range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: Vertices are labeled from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the maximum number of distinct leaves that can be visited in a valid move sequence.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout) == max(len(set(leaves)) for leaves in valid_sequences(n, k, p))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum number of distinct leaves that can be visited in any valid sequence of moves, where valid_sequences(n, k, p) generates all possible valid move sequences starting from root (vertex 1).
